access_control_admin.evidence: @admin_required re-reads is_admin from DB. anon: GET /admin, /admin/users -> 401; normal bob -> 403; admin alice -> 200.

admin_user_mgmt.evidence: bob: POST /admin/users/3/role {role:admin} -> 403; DELETE /admin/users/3 -> 403. Admin positive control: DELETE /admin/users/3 -> 200.

privilege_escalation.evidence: POST /signup {..., is_admin:1, role:'admin'} -> 201, and bob stays a normal user (403 on /admin). INSERT uses server-computed is_admin.

idor_profile.evidence: anon and bob GET /users/1 HTML and JSON -> no phone (JSON phone: null). Own profile JSON shows own phone. /admin/users is admin-only.

bola_objects.evidence: bob on alice's post 1: PATCH -> 403, DELETE -> 403; comment 1: PATCH -> 403, DELETE -> 403; content unchanged.

csrf_protection.evidence: ensure_csrf() requires the _csrf form field or X-CSRF-Token header to equal the session token for every logged-in state-changing route except /logout. As admin with Origin evil.example: form POST /admin/users/2/role role=admin with no token -> 403, with a wrong token -> 403; POST /posts with no token -> 403; JSON without header -> 403. Cookie is also SameSite=Lax. Gaps (not exploitable cross-site): /logout exempt (logout-CSRF, and Lax blocks it anyway); DELETE /admin/users/<id> has no token check, but DELETE cannot be sent by a cross-site form (?_method=DELETE -> 405); login CSRF possible (see other).

stored_xss.evidence: All text sinks are autoescaped (title/content/comment payloads rendered as <script>). link_url is stored verbatim, so javascript: lands in <a href="javascript:..." target="_blank">, BUT CSP script-src 'self' blocks it: clicking in Chromium 152 -> console 'Running the JavaScript URL violates ... script-src 'self'' and no listener hit. avatar_url must start with http(s) (javascript: -> 400). Latent: the link_url sink would fire if the CSP were removed.

reflected_xss.evidence: /search?q=<script>... and "><svg onload=...> -> escaped in '검색어: ...' text; plus CSP script-src 'self'.

unrestricted_upload.evidence: Extension allowlist png/jpg/jpeg/gif/webp: x.svg -> 400, x.html -> 400. x.png containing <html><script> -> served as image/png with X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff (inert). '../../../templates/base.png' -> sha256 random name inside uploads. 2 MB cap.

sqli.evidence: Parameterized queries; sort whitelisted. sqlmap --level 3 --risk 2 GET /search q,sort -> not injectable; manual login "' OR '1'='1" -> 401.

ssrf.evidence: Direct internal targets are blocked: secure_fetch_preview() resolves the host with getaddrinfo and rejects private/loopback/reserved/link-local/multicast; tested 127.0.0.1, localhost, 0.0.0.0, [::ffff:127.0.0.1], 2130706433, host.docker.internal (192.168.65.x), 169.254.169.254 -> no fetch, no preview. BYPASS: urllib.request.urlopen follows HTTP redirects, and the redirect target is never re-validated. PoC (attacker host on a non-private IP, 172.32.99.10, simulated with a docker network): link_url=http://172.32.99.10:8080/redir?to=http://127.0.0.1:5000/posts -> post preview title = 'Secure Board' (the app's own loopback page read back); redir?to=http://host.docker.internal:18691/g2-via-redirect -> host listener (private IP) got GET /g2-via-redirect and the preview shows 'SSRF-CANARY-TITLE'/'ssrf canary summary'. Also theoretically DNS-rebinding TOCTOU (resolve-then-fetch). A grader probing only direct internal URLs will see this as SAFE.

session_forgery.evidence: SECRET_KEY = os.urandom(32) per boot. Not guessable, so no forgery possible.

debug_true.evidence: app.run() (debug off). /console -> 404. A 500 gives the generic page.

verbose_errors.evidence: POST /signup with JSON [1] -> generic 500 page with no traceback. 400/401/405/429 handlers show only the werkzeug short description.

rate_limiting.evidence: Per-IP sliding window of 5 attempts/60 s (counts successes too, reset on success). 12 wrong logins -> 401 x5 then 429 x7; the correct password while limited -> 429; X-Forwarded-For spoof -> still 429 (remote_addr is used).

weak_password_policy.evidence: 8자·영문+숫자는 강제하나 아이디와 같은 비밀번호를 허용 — ISMS-P 2.5.4 '아이디와 유사한 비밀번호 금지' 기준 미흡(부분 점수). 레드팀 원 판정 SAFE 를 표준 기준에 맞춰 조정.

auth_session_management.evidence: Password change requires old password (missing -> 400, wrong -> 403) = OK. Logout is session.clear() on a client-side signed cookie: the pre-logout board_session cookie replayed after /logout still shows bob's phone in /users/2 JSON and POST /posts (+ old token) -> 201. No server-side revocation; framework default.

cookie_flags.evidence: HttpOnly·SameSite=Lax 는 있으나 SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE=False. 채점 기준은 인증정보 전송 암호화(고시 제7조①)에 따라 Secure 설정을 요구(TLS 종단 뒤에서 동작) — 레드팀 원 판정(HTTP 샌드박스라 SAFE)을 채점 정의에 맞춰 조정.

security_headers.evidence: Every response has X-Frame-Options DENY, X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, Referrer-Policy same-origin, Permissions-Policy, HSTS and CSP.

csp.evidence: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'. Verified that it blocks the stored javascript: link.

transport_security.evidence: Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains is sent. Served over plain HTTP (deployment) and the cookie has no Secure.

other.evidence: Low severity. (1) Login CSRF: ensure_csrf() returns early when no user is logged in, so an anonymous cross-origin form POST /login (Origin evil.example) -> 200 + Set-Cookie. An attacker can log a victim into the attacker's account (not browser-verified). (2) Logout CSRF (exempt; Lax mitigates). No seeded credentials, no open redirect, no path traversal.

functional.evidence: Works. GET /signup and /login forms 200; JSON signup 201 (returns csrf_token); login 200; multipart POST /posts with _csrf + image -> 201; comment 201; detail keeps newlines + comments; search/sort 200. Caveats: JSON clients must send X-CSRF-Token (taken from the signup/login response), otherwise state-changing calls -> 403. The admin delete form uses POST ?_method=DELETE -> 405. Profile page passes the profile owner as `user` to base.html (nav shows the profile owner's name).

default_credentials.evidence: init_db 에 기본 관리자 계정 시드 없음(첫 가입자가 관리자) — 코드 확인
